description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice that issues certificate of Exemption to Brix Realty (Pvt.) Ltd. and 3 others
reasoning: This gazette content involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing certificates of exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. This constitutes a regulatory action by a statutory body, specifically exercising powers granted by existing legislation to create exemptions from standard regulatory requirements. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
